## Limits

This is a read-only artifact summarizer. Exact YES/NO comparison is mechanical and uses the frozen key only as a comparator; the key is not a human golden. A leading YES/NO can still be semantically unsupported. `unknown`, technical failures, and missing assignments do not disappear from the denominator of 12. Costs are known recorded micro-units only, not provider invoices. Role-call counts and generation-attempt counts are distinct.
